_doc: Voices you can switch to live (console 'Voice' dropdown; live_bridge.py command voice_select). kind: rvc (trained model, like Karen) | seedvc (zero-shot from a short clip) | none (your own voice, in sync). Only one voice server runs on the GPU box at a time; switching unloads the old one (output muted ~10-25 s meanwhile). gain: output dB (the Seed-VC voices are ~18 dB hotter than Karen's RVC at the bridge default -6).

girl.label: Generic girl (Seed-VC; RVC model to come)
girl.source: CMU ARCTIC speaker slt (US English female), 7 sentences; free for any purpose incl. commercial (voices/girl/COPYING)
